project_summary: VisualMark Studio is a modern desktop IDE built with Electron, Vite, and Python for authoring Markdown documentation alongside interactive Mermaid diagrams. It blends code-first workflows with visual studios and sidecar backend processing to deliver a comprehensive documentation authoring environment.
core_features: Dual-mode authoring combining code-first Markdown editing with visual diagram generation studios
Embedded Python sidecar architecture built into packaged binaries for backend operations
Native OS file associations and shell integration for .md and .markdown documents
Production packaging workflows supporting both NSIS Windows installers and portable executables
quickstart_instructions:
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/JagaTheGhost/visualmark-studio.git
cd visualmark-studio/frontend

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Build backend sidecar
npm run sidecar:build

# Launch desktop application in development mode
npm run electron:dev
